outcome.technical: Seventeen fragment builders + _RISK_LEVELS moved to _report_html.py (448 lines, stdlib + _ui_theme only); render-report aliases every name and drops its now-unused import html. The 227 existing cases were all whole-document integration pins and stayed; 51 new unit cases cover the moved functions directly (escaping, URL safety, chip grammar, bar math). 227 + 51 = 278 >= 227. Acme-store re-render byte-identical to HEAD apart from the wall-clock stamp.
outcome.descriptive: The report's HTML fragments live at the bottom of their own graph with direct unit coverage, and shipped reports render exactly as before.

outcome.technical: The whole usage region (ledger load, every chart builder, _usage_section and the markdown twin _usage_md) moved to _report_usage.py (1365 lines); render-report 2803 -> 1613 with 33 aliases. 227 = 178 + 49 moved; borderline calls documented (composition pins stayed; u4's siblings assert off _usage_section directly; u27's source scan now reads both files by path so the rule keeps covering the file it left). Byte-identity proven on acme-store with the stamp normalized inside AUDIT_MD_B64 as well. Real find en route: u8 was green off the stylesheet's variable declarations rather than the markup - re-aimed at _phase_stacks exact segments and proven red under reversed model order.
outcome.descriptive: Every usage chart and its markdown twin live in their own module with their own cases, one of which turned out to have been a decoration and now bites.
